stated_claims: Fully prepared meals that go from fridge to plate in 2 minutes
Targeting busy professionals and fitness folks

Adjacent category; fitness-minded consumers frequently seek convenient high-protein or healthy meal options.
Adjacent category; targets fitness folks who focus on nutrition convenience.
